semanticGuards: T_PRELIM is auxiliary/preliminary; T+1 may revise and T+2 is final.
Day-trading buy and sell values are same-session turnover measures and do not identify overnight directional inventory.
Aggregate buy-sell value difference must not be used as a clean directional position signal.
The TWSE 60% surveillance criterion is not a TPEx alpha threshold and is not used here.
Later T+1/T+2 values must be appended as new vintages and must not overwrite this T_PRELIM receipt.
Retrieval channel is not source authority; TPEx remains the primary source.
